headline: Morgan Stanley Projects Global Refinery Outages to Rise by 3.4 Million Bpd
summary: Morgan Stanley expects global oil refinery outages to increase by 3.4 million barrels per day as operators conduct deferred maintenance, potentially curbing downstream product supplies.
why: Refinery run rates directly influence margins, fuel prices, and crack spreads across worldwide retail energy markets.

impacts.name: Global Refining
impacts.why: Deferred maintenance tightens refined fuel inventories, supporting crack spreads but lowering crude intake.
